estimand: Conditional predictive association between a person's latest earlier normalized candidate overperformance and their later normalized overperformance in the same electorate on unchanged geography. It is not causal or uniquely personal vote retention.
unit: Ordered pair of held, eligible, normalized candidate-election occurrences for the same evidenced person, in adjacent observed general elections and the same electorate and boundary regime.
units: Residuals are vote-share fractions internally; errors and summaries are percentage points. Stage 7 candidate and party valid-vote denominators remain separate and unchanged.
identity: Keep Stage 7 occurrence IDs and source names immutable. Store separate person links with source evidence, method and confidence. Ambiguous homonyms, aliases without corroboration and conflicting simultaneous occurrences remain explicitly unresolved. A party or electorate match alone never establishes a person. Primary pairs require an official Parliament profile, compatible observed winning occurrence and unique full-source-name/affiliation/seat chain. Exact-record chains without that external corroboration are probable and enter sensitivity only.
historyStatus: Store election-time status separately from identity and party. Prior parliamentary tenure before 2008 is left-censored unless independently evidenced. Leadership is orthogonal. Unknown is retained rather than inferred as new or first-term. No status effects are fitted.
geography: Primary pairs require the same named electorate, electorate type and validated boundary regime in one of the three observed same-boundary transitions. A name match across changed regimes is insufficient. Seat-switch and changed-boundary links are retained for coverage diagnostics, not primary fitting.
predictor: Latest earlier same-person Stage 7 normalized residual, known before target election; primary additive nationally centered scale.
outcome: Target election's observed normalized residual, used only after the target election for evaluation. Target observed votes, party shares, leave-one-out reference and residual never enter a predictor or training set for that target.
missingness: Exclude from fitting pairs without evidenced identity, held contests, exact party counterpart, normalized residual or geography comparability; retain occurrence and pair exclusion counts and reasons. No imputation or synthetic candidate votes.
fit: General-scope ordinary least squares of target residual on an intercept and prior residual; full-sample fit is descriptive only. Intercept is permitted because Stage 7 residuals are not constrained to mean zero among selected returnees. Zero-intercept fit is a sensitivity, not an inherited Stage 6 restriction.
validation: Score 2011 with benchmarks only. For 2017 fit only 2011 target pairs; for 2023 fit only 2011 and 2017 target pairs. Use known target candidacy as a condition, so these are conditional historical predictions rather than complete pre-election forecasts. Report MAE, RMSE and bias per transition and equal-transition summaries.
sensitivity: Repeat coverage, descriptive fit and chronological scores on proportional and log-odds Stage 7 residuals. Repeat additive analysis including probable exact-record chains, explicitly labelled as identity-uncertain. Report Maori scope separately without a bespoke operational coefficient if sparse. Inspect no-intercept fit and bounded same-seat/stable-environment diagnostics without fitting replacement effects.
dependence: Shared party/election reference offsets, repeated people and only three transition clusters invalidate candidate-pair iid election-level inference. Report descriptive uncertainty and transition-level variability, not causal confidence intervals.
selectionBias: Only returning, evidenced and comparable candidates can form pairs; election candidacy and party selection are conditions of the sample. Stable electorate/party environments can mimic persistence.
operationalSelection: Select a non-null operational coefficient only if each trained holdout improves MAE by at least 0.25 percentage points over the better of zero and unchanged-prior benchmarks without worse RMSE, scale sensitivities agree in direction, and identity coverage supports returnees beyond the MP-selected confirmed subset. The 0.25 point threshold is a practical diagnostic, not a significance test. Otherwise select null and preserve descriptive fits. Never stack a residual coefficient independently onto Stage 6.
outputs: Pinned input contract, person links/unresolved records, history/status evidence, pair eligibility and exclusions, descriptive fits, chronological benchmarks, sensitivity, nullable selection and deterministic manifest. Prior Stage 7 and earlier outputs remain byte-identical.
reproducibility: Offline deterministic regeneration and --check mode; source/documentary evidence and all input/code/output hashes in the manifest. No runtime web access.
